name: knowledgebase-docs
description: Docs tooling and markdown link checker. This is NOT a workspace for the product packages — cloudflare/worker and app each keep their own pnpm-lock.yaml.

scripts.quality: pnpm quality:format && pnpm docs:check && pnpm --dir app check && pnpm --dir app build && pnpm --dir app test:coverage && pnpm --dir cloudflare/worker typecheck && pnpm --dir cloudflare/worker test:coverage && pnpm --dir landing-astro check && pnpm quality:unused && pnpm quality:complexity && pnpm quality:duplication && pnpm quality:dependencies && pnpm quality:cycles && pnpm quality:suppressions && pnpm quality:hygiene
